flavor.phonemic_palette: classical (hellenic register: the polis and the oracle, -os/-on/-e/-eus endings, aspirates th/ph/kh, patronymic -id-, vowel-rich open syllables, root-penultimate stress, the archon and the basileus) / mesoamerican (mayan: the jungle city-states of the witz-pyramid and the carved stela, the ballgame and the bloodletting-rite, glottalized stops and the agentive aj-/ix-, the jade/cacao/maize wealth, the day-lord calendar that orders the realm beneath the oracle)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Oracmaya — cosmopolitan merchant oligarchy of the synthesis; law, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Oracmaya are a vigorous merchant oligarchy people, a first-order synthesis of Hellaspol and Tollanaz [Peer Synthesis / Mercantile]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_infantry, marines. Outsiders are met as cosmopolitan; their patrons touch war.
